explication: Source 2 Viewer is a desktop asset-inspection tool plus CLI/library: users open Source 2 resources, the GUI browses and dispatches them to format-specific viewers, while rendering, animation, particle, and graph subsystems produce visual results; users can also export or decompile assets. The CLI provides a non-GUI decompilation path. The graph emphasizes documented product responsibilities and directly evidenced sampled runtime behavior; several GUI-to-format dispatch links are architectural inferences from named components and may require unsampled source to verify.
